messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm consolidating the SDK snippet updates for streaming + retries + pagination into a single rollout. I opened a meta docs PR to track language-specific PRs. Need reviewers and a merge order. TL;DR: Python/TS/Go examples should use async iterators / stream helpers and the retry param name changed to `max_attempts` (was `retries`).
jeff: link? :eyes:
maria: Meta PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/621
Individual PRs: python: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/619, typescript: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/620, go: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/618
kai: Go PR failing unit tests — snippets referencing StreamUntil done; new runtime uses StreamRecv(ctx) which returns (Chunk, done, err). I'll paste the small snippet we want: ```go // streaming example for iterator-like consumption client := inference.NewClient(apiKey) ctx := context.Background() s, err := client.Stream(ctx, req) for { chunk, done, err := s.Recv() if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } fmt.Print(chunk.Text) if done { break } } ```
alisa: For TypeScript let's move examples to async iterator (modern style). Proposed snippet: ```ts // TS streaming example for docs const stream = client.stream(req) for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text) } ```
jeff: Python snippet looks fine but we need to show retry config rename. Proposed: ```py # python streaming + retry example client = RedwoodClient(api_key) with client.stream(req, max_attempts=3) as s: for chunk in s: print(chunk.text, end="") ```
devex: Heads-up — changing `retries` -> `max_attempts` needs a short migration blurb in the SDK changelog and a redirect note in the docs so users searching for `retries` find the new name. I'll add a short section under "SDK migration notes".
ci-bot: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions — docs-pipeline failed on PR 621: md-lint (line-length) and missing codeblock language hints in go example.
maria: Thanks CI. Kai — can you drop the code fence language and wrap the example to 100 chars? Also please update the example to call `s.Recv()` as above.
kai: Yep, fixing now. I'll also add a tiny comment explaining `done` bool.
alisa: I'll update TS PR to match the streaming API and tweak the example to show `abortController` usage for cancellation. Small snippet: ```ts const ac = new AbortController() const stream = client.stream(req, { signal: ac.signal, max_attempts: 2 }) for await (const chunk of stream) { if (shouldStop()) { ac.abort(); break } console.log(chunk.text) } ```
jeff: I'm taking the migration blurb for Python — will include backward-compat wrapper note and an example mapping old param to new one.
maria: Merge order proposal: 1) docs/pull/619 (python) after jeff adds migration blurb, 2) docs/pull/620 (ts) after alisa updates cancellation example, 3) docs/pull/618 (go) after kai fixes lint + tests, then 4) meta PR 621 to close and publish the consolidated note. Ping me when each is green.
devex: I'll add the redirect from `retries` to `max_attempts` and a one-liner in the changelog.
ci-bot: Update: PR 618 tests pass in staging once Go example wrapped. CI green for 618.
kai: Done — pushed change, PTAL. I also added a quick note: "Go streaming returns a (Chunk, done bool, error) tuple; use done to stop reading."
jeff: Python PR updated with migration blurb and a cross-link to the SDK changelog. CI green for 619.
alisa: TS PR updated with `AbortController` example and docs lint fixes. CI green for 620. Added a short sentence about pagination interplay with streaming (use cursor tokens if you need to resume).
maria: Awesome work team. I'm merging in that order now. Will wait 15m for any last objections. :shipit:
(15 minutes later)
ci-bot: All PRs merged: 619, 620, 618, meta 621. Docs site build succeeded — https://docs.redwood.ai/updates/sdk-snippet-streaming-retries-migration
maria: Released. I'll follow up with a short notes email and add a row to the release tracking sheet. Thanks everyone! :tada:
